notes: Current authority is PDV_SubstratePacingContracts.json. The dedicated cultural-practice metric grants at most +4 per devotional day. Hist, People, and Void remain independent relation ledgers; only act-specific Hist/water sources award Hist piety, People/bed sources affect relation only, and activated Void sources award Sithis. The former Hist Communion boon family is retired and never granted.
contractOverride: The 2026-07-13 substrate contract supersedes every legacy composite, per-route magnitude, shared Histcarp, double-route, and Hist Communion statement retained below for record archaeology.

deityQuests.role: scripted patron target for the small honest Hist piety pulse; the substrate (PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist) carries the actual reward gating

high-threshold tertiary Void patron; only scored after >=3 significant Void signals across separate beats (PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist.VoidActivationSignalsRequired=3). Must NOT become the obvious Argonian route.

substrateBoons.wireToScriptNote: Substrate quest editorId carrying the slot properties is PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist (extends PDV_SubstrateBase). StorageUtil key contract is PDV.Substrate.ArgonianHist.* (Hist/People/Void/Posture/SithisSignalCount/BedOfChoiceSleepCount/LastMaintenanceDay/LastDecayDay). Posture enum PDV_State_ArgonianHistPosture: Normal(0), Distant(1), Strained(2), Silenced(3), Corrupted(4).

slots.consolidation: highest-slot-only; each slot carries the cumulative total
slots.playerFacingText: The Hist remembers you across the distance. Your resistance to magic rises by 5%.
The Hist reaches a little closer. Magic finds less purchase (5%) and your resistance to poison rises 10%. Near water, the Hist steadies you, raising your Maximum Health +20.
You are deeply attuned to the Hist even far from the marsh. Magic finds little purchase (5%) and poison fails (22%). Near water, the Hist fortifies you, raising your Maximum Health +30.

substrateBoons.substratePowerNote: Mirrors the proven Khajiit substrate triad shape and power level (Always low + Mid + High climbing). Water-breathing is omitted because it is already Argonian racial; boons are themed to Hist/water identity (ResistDisease, HealRateMult near water/rest, ResistPoison). nearWaterOnly conditions are the Argonian analogue of the Khajiit nightOnly conditions; the always-on identity boon is unconditional, the contextual climb keys off near-water/rest context. 2026-06-23: the substrate Mid/High Health pool was converted to a near-water HealRateMult regen (Requiem-proof >100 band, a documented exception to the T2 15 / T3 30 HealRateMult ceiling per PDV_RequiemRegenFlips_Proposal); the substrate Unarmed claw moved to the Void/Sithis focus; restores the locked design's 'Hist Health is near-water, absence not abundance'.

nearWaterContext.note: Generous near-water gate for every nearWaterOnly reward effect. GetInCurrentLocFormList walks the location parent chain, so the two hold entries (Hjaalmarch 01676E, Rift 01676C) blanket those wet holds and the settlement entries catch the river/lake towns. Open-water wilderness outside a named location does not match (acceptable per the 'near the water places' contract). Generic/promotable name -- NOT the 6-site ArgonianSacredWaters pilgrimage list (those sites are folded in here).

neglect.biteCondition: Mechanical bite applies only at posture Silenced or Corrupted (vampire grief / domination), per PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist.RefreshHistPosture and the ledger curse posture. Ordinary Distant posture remains relation texture without this debuff.
neglect.playerFacingText: The curse silences the Hist's reach. Maximum Health -10 until the silence is broken.
neglect.decayRule: Dawn Hist decay only after 3 days without valid maintenance (HistDawnGraceDays=3), then -1 per dawn (HistDawnDecay=1.0), non-curse floor 20 (HistNonCurseFloor=20.0); curse-active floor is MetricMin. Ordinary distance is texture; this debuff is the Silenced/Corrupted curse consequence.

emphasisRewards.consolidation: highest-tier-only; each tier carries the cumulative total
emphasisRewards.playerFacingText: The Hist keeps a steadying hand on you near water. Maximum Health +10 when you are in or near water.
The Hist holds you close even in exile. Your Maximum Stamina rises +25; near water your Maximum Health rises +20.
You carry the marsh within you. Your Maximum Stamina rises +25 and your resistance to poison rises 10%; near water your Maximum Health rises +30.
The people you chose look out for you. You can carry 25 more weight.
Your chosen family steadies you. You carry 25 more weight, poison resistance rises 8%, and Maximum Health +10.
You are a pillar of the people you gathered. You carry 50 more weight, poison resistance rises 8%, Maximum Health +20, and magic finds less purchase (5%).
emphasisRewards.recognition: V1 Champion Survey text only (non-voiced); voiced NPC recognition is V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md

emphasisRewards.voidGate: scored only after PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist.IsVoidFullyActive() (>=3 Void signals across separate beats)
emphasisRewards.playerFacingText: Having faced the Void, you move a little quieter. Sneak +4.
The Void has marked your passing. Sneak +10, poison resistance rises 5%, and your bare strikes carry the Void's weight (+10 unarmed).
emphasisRewards.ceilingNote: Deliberately weaker than the People T3 ceiling and below the Hist signature; Void must not become the best generic stealth path.

emphasisRewards.playerFacingText: Sithis holds those who faced the Void unflinching. Your Maximum Stamina rises +25, your bare strikes carry the Void's weight (+12 unarmed), and near death the Void can lend a brief surge.
emphasisRewards.ceilingNote: User-locked 2026-06-14: Sithis T3 is a two-part capstone, passive Fortify Stamina +25 (Requiem-converted 2026-07-13) plus a once/day below-20%-health burst.

supportSpells.playerFacingText: Near death, the Void lends a brief surge. Stamina returns 50% faster for 10 seconds.

emphasisLayerDesignNote: Per the THIN budget and reward ceiling (Hist substrate plus ONE strongest active support emphasis, People OR Void): Hist is the broad set T1(25 ~5%)/T2(50, capped Faithful, ~7-8%) plus a signature at 75. People is the modest practical-support set AND the ONE focused 3-tier emphasis (T1/T2/T3 Champion at 85). Sithis is intentionally only a 2-tier high-threshold tertiary, gated behind the 3-signal Void activation, with magnitudes below the People focus so it stabilizes rather than replaces Hist and never becomes the best generic stealth/combat route. No magnitude exceeds ~12%. <=2 always-on boon families (the Hist substrate triad is family one; the single foreground emphasis the player runs is family two). Broad sets (Hist, People modest) stay below the focused People T3 / Hist signature ceiling.

creedViolation.scope: medium/major only (Hist abandonment / corruption signals); no minor-tier loss

deltas.trigger: extended Hist neglect carried past the 3-day grace into posture Distant while still neglecting (medium)
deltas.playerFacingText: The Hist has felt your absence. Its memory of you grows thin.

deltas.trigger: domination pressure driving posture to Corrupted (vampire grief plus domination per RefreshHistPosture) (major)
deltas.playerFacingText: Something has come between you and the Hist. The connection is fouled.

deltas.trigger: leaning hard into Void/Sithis signals while Hist maintenance has lapsed past grace (major; Void must not replace Hist)
deltas.playerFacingText: You reached for the Void and let the Hist slip. The marsh feels further away.

doubleRoute.summary: Superseded 2026-07-13: one act-specific cultural route may claim the shared daily substrate credit; only the deity or relation lane named by that act changes.

acts.realHookSource: vanilla sleep + location context near safe water / wetland / safe-refuge (signalId argonian-hist-water-rest-maintenance; favorFamilies hist-near-water + hist-reflection); optional vanilla bowl/note/marker ritual surface. NOT generic swimming or standing in water.

vanilla sleep in the player-designated chosen bed (signalId argonian-hist-water-rest-maintenance / RouteArgonianBedOfChoice; bed-of-choice cadence: 3 qualifying sleeps in a rolling 30 in-game days, one active chosen bed). NOT generic inn sleep or same-bed repetition.
acts.substrateDelta: BedOfChoiceDelta 3.0 * repeat multiplier (routes to People relation)
acts.antiFarmSubstrate: ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier 0.7^n + chosen-bed memory (oncePerDayKey PDV.Signal.ArgonianBedOfChoice); missed cadence applies light People decay, not harsh punishment

acts.realHookSource: curated Windhelm Argonian Assemblage + Riften docks community/service contexts and named Argonian aid (signalId argonian-people-community-support; favorFamilies community-saxhleel-aid + community-assemblage-kept). NOT random Argonian proximity or generic helping.
acts.antiFarmSubstrate: ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier 0.7^n (oncePerDayKey PDV.Signal.ArgonianPeopleSupport), one accepted community source per day/quest marker

acts.realHookSource: curated Dark-Brotherhood death-change quest-stages and curated death-facing choices (signalId argonian-void-threshold; favorFamilies void-death-faced + void-brotherhood-contract). One Dark Brotherhood join is one major signal, NOT full activation. NOT generic murder, ordinary kills, or generic stealth.
acts.targetDeity: PDV_Deity_Sithis (high-threshold; PDV_Deity_Hist pulse remains the honest universal-layer route)
acts.substrateDelta: VoidSignalDelta 2.0 * repeat multiplier (does NOT score Sithis emphasis reward until IsVoidFullyActive, >=3 signals)
acts.pietyPulseDelta: +1 small honest pulse to PDV_Deity_Hist (the universal layer stays Hist-honest even on the Void route)
acts.antiFarmSubstrate: Three-signal threshold (VoidActivationSignalsRequired=3) + one-shot markers per source + ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier 0.7^n (oncePerDayKey PDV.Signal.ArgonianVoidSignal)

pace.model: substrate-led (no piety faucet race), mirroring the Khajiit substrate cadence.
pace.substrateCadence: One authentic cultural-practice act per 06:00 devotional day grants +4; day 7 reaches 28 and day 19 caps at 75. Hist, People, and Void relation values never compose the cultural metric.
pace.pietyPulseRole: The small +1 Hist pulse per act is NOT a progression race; it only keeps the universal piety layer (decay/neglect/creed-loss) honest so the substrate-led design does not float free of the shared piety mechanics.
pace.decayBalance: Dawn Hist decay is -1/dawn only after 3 days without maintenance, non-curse floor 20 (HistDawnDecay/HistDawnGraceDays/HistNonCurseFloor). Ordinary play (a few maintenance beats per week) trends maintainable; a fully neglected exile drifts toward Distant but never below the non-curse floor unless cursed.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The People T3 Champion 'Chosen People - Pillar' recognition surface is V1 Survey text only; voiced NPC recognition lines (Windhelm/Riften community, Arkay death-rite reactions) are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md and the ledger 'Needs custom content' note.
budget: THIN (PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Focused Pass: Argonian). Two always-on families: the Hist substrate triad (Layer 1, loud identity) plus the one foreground support emphasis the player runs (People focus by default, Layer 2). People is the modest practical buffer AND the single focused 3-tier set; Sithis/Void is a high-threshold 2-tier tertiary gated behind 3 signals and is intentionally weaker than the People focus. At the two-family cap; Hist primary, People practical, Void tertiary -- not three equal tracks. Reward ceiling and floor per ledger respected; no magnitude exceeds ~12%.
ceilingReviewApplied20260614: Percent-mult crossings clamped to Requiem ceilings (Magicka/Stamina/ResistMagic T2 10/T3 20; HealRateMult T2 15/T3 30; ResistDisease T2 30/T3 50). DamageResist rescaled to the armor-points ladder T1 15/T2 30/T3 50 (armor points are exempt from the flat ~12 magnitude ceiling because +4 AR is ~0.3% damage reduction in Requiem). Per the 2026-06-14 Requiem ceiling review; mirrors the Orc spec.
